MLI.note: Decree names an HR system project steering the staff enrolment, not a payroll system in use.

facts.fact: The decree cites Law n°2013-015 of 21 May 2013, as amended, on protection of personal data, and applies it to staff access and rectification rights.
facts.system: Loi n°2013-015 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The decree cites APDP deliberation n°2023-099 of 31 March 2023 giving an opinion on the Ministry of Refondation's draft decree authorising the staff biometric enrolment.
The APDP gave an opinion (deliberation n°2023-099 of 31 March 2023) on a draft decree authorising personal data processing for the civil servant biometric enrolment.
